caption: The drawing features a single horizontal rectangular strip centered on a plain, beige background with some visible brownish spots and marks scattered throughout. The rectangular strip is divided into three main sections. On the left, there is a pattern of blue and white horizontal lines overlaid with repeated blue leaf-like or crescent shapes. The middle portion is composed of alternating vertical stripes of blue and white. The rightmost section has a dense, consistent pattern of close-set vertical black lines over a light background, possibly bluish in hue. In the lower left corner of the drawing, the name "LESTER KAUNICH" is handwritten in black.
title: Silk Gown (Detail)
